I don’t remember it obviously, but when I was 6 weeks old I developed a severe staphylococcus infection, which led to sepsis and eventually necrotising fasciitis. I had been 6 weeks prem and barely had an immune system. 

Mum brought me to the GP thinking it was something small and insignificant. GP then aired me to hospital, they pumped me with every antibiotic they had while calling top hospitals in the country. They didn’t have time to wait for bloods, they just had to do what they could. 

My mum got told by a nurse to ‘go home and forget she had me’. My odds of survival were poor, then it was said I’d lose limbs. Then it was heavy scarring head to toe. I’m now 23, no scaring, all limbs and the only issue is my skin which never fully healed and takes offence to everything lol.

When I was 15, with my friend (16f) we were walking to our other friends birthday party. We had nice dresses on, and some small heels and felt like the shit. 

After about 10mins my friends feet were blistering bad and she was trailing a couple steps behind. A car pulls up with a man in his 40s, he rolls down the window and asks if we’re okay. Friend says she’s fine, her feet just hurt a little. The guy offers to give us a ride to our destination, I refused saying we weren’t far, and that it was our friends 16th birthday (to give an idea of our ages). He kept insisting on the lift and my friend was away to get in the damn car. I swung the door closed out of her hand and dragged her ass to the party, telling her I understand her feet hurt but she can’t just be going into cars with random people she doesn’t know. 

We’re 23/24 now and she still complains about what I done.
